messages:
maria_partnerships: Quick sync — need clarified price/supply inputs from VoltCloud (reserved vs spot) for next week's cost model run. Main asks: reserves (tenors + min commitment), spot historical variance, eviction notice behavior.

vicky_hw: Hey! we can share a feed. high-level: reserved tenors 3/6/12mo; min commit is 8 GPUs per region; reserved billed monthly, prorated for partial months. spot avg price ~40–60% of reserved but high variance in NA-west.

sam_finance: thanks. can you include effective monthly amortized USD per GPU and the discount tiers (volume bands)? we need to compute committed monthly OPEX.

jia_ops: also pls include historical availability percent per SKU (daily over 90d) and eviction_rate_30d. we use those histograms to model preempt probability.

alex_p: for the cost model mapping we'll need these fields in CSV: `sku`, `region`, `commit_months`, `min_commit_gpus`, `reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_per_month`, `spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour`, `avg_avail_pct_90d`, `eviction_rate_30d`, `eviction_notice_seconds`, `burst_capacity_gpus`, `billing_proration_policy`.

vicky_hw: yep — we can produce that. sample CSV snippet:

```
sku,region,commit_months,min_commit_gpus,reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_per_month,spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,avg_avail_pct_90d,eviction_rate_30d,eviction_notice_seconds,burst_capacity_gpus,billing_proration_policy
vc-p100,us-west-2,12,8,1200,0.65,92.4,0.03,1800,16,monthly-prorate
vc-p100,us-east-1,3,8,1350,0.80,88.1,0.07,900,8,monthly-prorate
```

note: spot prices are sample medians, we will include percentiles (p10/p50/p90) in the full feed. reserved_price is list price before volume discount. we offer volume bands 8-32,33-128,>128 with 5/10/18% discounts.

sam_finance: perfect. confirm reserved billing is prorated to the second level? and is there a penalty if we downscale early? need to model breakage.

vicky_hw: prorated daily for the month; contract early termination has a 15% remaining-commitment fee unless you reassign credits to other regions (depends on contract). we'll flag in the CSV as `early_termination_fee_pct`.

jia_ops: can you push availability CSV + eviction time series to the secure S3 feed? prefer UTC timestamps, hourly buckets. we will hook it into the simulator.

vicky_hw: will do. ETA EOD PT. sending initial sample to the s3 path `s3://vendor-feeds/voltcloud/volumes/2026-03/` and will ping once uploaded.

maria_partnerships: awesome — pls cc @legal if there are new contract terms (early termination / reassignment). everyone: i'll run the cost model with these inputs tomorrow and post results. thanks :party_parrot: 

vendor-bot: voltage-feed-uploader uploaded `voltcloud_supply_sample_20260315.csv` to s3://vendor-feeds/voltcloud/volumes/2026-03/ (size 42KB)
